Iframe tags preserved as raw HTML in output

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"preserve_tags":["iframe"]}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<p>Before</p><iframe src=\'video.html\' width=\'560\'></iframe><p>After</p>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
